# Palatka Homes Report

> Independent public-record report on new construction, subdivisions, and living in Palatka, East Palatka, and Putnam County, Florida.

This site is not Putnam County, not a builder, and not a brokerage. County PDFs win if they disagree with a page here.

## Highest-intent pages

- [What's being built in Palatka](https://www.palatkahomesreport.com/): report home
- [New Palatka subdivisions](https://www.palatkahomesreport.com/developments)
- [Alford Farms, East Palatka](https://www.palatkahomesreport.com/developments/alford-farms): PUD24-000004, Ordinance 2024-017, 559-lot engineering layout, D.R. Horton named as agent, not selling yet
- [The Collection at Palatka](https://www.palatkahomesreport.com/developments/collection-at-palatka): Century Complete, 508 N. 17th Street, selling in-town new construction
- [Buy now or wait](https://www.palatkahomesreport.com/decide): Collection (selling) vs Alford Farms (still a PUD file)
- [Decode a Palatka address](https://www.palatkahomesreport.com/address): city vs unincorporated, flood map, utilities
- [Lists for a Palatka house](https://www.palatkahomesreport.com/house): storm, first summer, well lot, work from home, yard, closing week
- [Storm list](https://www.palatkahomesreport.com/storm): water, lights, well vs city, who to call
- [Moving to Palatka living guide](https://www.palatkahomesreport.com/guide)
- [Palatka housing FAQ](https://www.palatkahomesreport.com/faq)

## Facts people search

- Alford Farms is in unincorporated East Palatka on SR 207 / Alford Road, not downtown Palatka.
- Putnam County approved the Alford Farms PUD on August 13, 2024. That is not a recorded plat or a sales opening.
- Rezoning materials said up to 700 homes; later engineering shows 559 lots.
- The Collection at Palatka by Century Complete is a separate, smaller community at 508 N. 17th Street, advertised as selling from the low $200,000s.
- Clay Electric Cooperative and FPL both serve Putnam County. Territory is by power line, not by city name.
- A PUD school map is marketing. Putnam County School District assignment is the record.
